lesson_text: Oops Reversal (scanner version): opens below the prior close, trades under the prior day's low, then reverses and closes above the prior close. A Williams Oops opens below the prior LOW and rallies back above it. A Super Oops is any Oops that closes above the prior day's HIGH, engulfing the whole day (owner ruling 2026-10-23). Here it opened 0.48% from the prior low and closed up 11.57%: a Super Oops: it also closed above the prior day's high. The setup was already there: the stock was above its 200-day, had pulled back 12.6% from its 20-day high, the dip tested the 21 or 50-day average, and the close reclaimed the 21-day average.
